parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy moved the robber to Hex 4 (Sheep 8). This hits my settlement at Node 20. He's justifying it by my road expansion blocking him. This confirms Jimmy isn't a neutral party anymore; he's actively hindering my progress to clear space for himself. I need to keep an eye on his wood count and his path to the center. Both Claude and Jimmy are now using the 'balance' excuse to target me.
parsed.note_to_self: Jimmy blocked Sheep 8 and stole from me. He feels pressured by my roads. He has 2 Wood and 2 Wheat. Claude still has a hidden dev card. My priority remains settling Node 33.
